title: In situ growth of carbon nanotubes on MXenes for high-performance electromagnetic wave absorption
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,26506-26514
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03991F, Paper

Zhichao Mu, Lanzhi Wang, Benhui Fan, Zuojuan Du, Jianling Yue, Yu Liu, Xiaozhong Huang
The MXene@SiO2–CNTs composite, with uniform carbon nanotube coating, achieves an exceptional minimum reflection loss (−48.38 dB) and broad absorption bandwidth (5.47 GHz) at only 2.1 mm thickness, while its radar cross-section values below −15 dBm2.
